objectives.statement: Place sentence adverbs after the finite verb in ordinary main clauses.
Place sentence adverbs before the finite verb in subordinate clauses.
Choose the natural position of sentence adverbs after fronting, including pronoun and heavier noun subjects.
Recognize and correct common sentence-adverb placement errors.

notes: Must contrast sentence-adverb placement in main clauses and subordinate clauses. Include main-clause finite verb before ikke and subordinate-clause ikke before finite verb, plus the pronoun-vs-heavy-noun placement pattern after fronting.
